name: Shoko Anime
description: Shoko is an anime cataloging and management program designed to automate the cataloging of your anime collection.
longDescription:
Shoko is a centralized anime management system designed to automate the cataloging and organization of your anime collection.

By integrating directly with AniDB, Shoko uses precise file hashing (CRC32) to accurately identify files regardless of filename, fetching detailed metadata, episode information, character lists, and artwork.

Key features include:

  • AniDB Integration: Automatic identification and metadata matching powered by AniDB.
  • Multi-Client Support: Works as a backend server for Web UI, Shoko Desktop, Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby plugins.
  • File Organization: Automates file renaming, moving, and duplicate management.
  • Comprehensive Management: Tracks watch status, series relations, episode groups, and missing file alerts.
